metadata.scenario: A prospect calls to clarify an invoice they received, which included services they didn’t request. Category: Billing. Flags: billing_dispute. Customer type: prospect.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret speaking. How can I assist you today? Hi, Margaret. This is Harold Gonzalez. I'm calling about an invoice I received. Hi, Harold! I’m happy to help with that. Can you tell me what specific concerns you have? Yes, there are charges for services I didn’t request, and I want to clarify those. I understand. Can you please provide me with the invoice number or the date of service? Sure, it’s invoice number 123456 from last week. Thank you. Let me pull that up quickly. One moment, please. Okay, I see the invoice here. It looks like there are charges for both wound care management and companion care. Is that correct? Yes, but I only requested skilled nursing for vital sign checks. I apologize for the confusion, Harold. Let me check on that for you. Thank you. I was surprised to see those extra services. I can imagine. It’s important to resolve this. One moment while I check the service logs. It appears there was a misunderstanding during the scheduling. The caregiver may have added those extra services based on an assessment. But I didn’t authorize anything beyond the skilled nursing. You’re absolutely right, Harold. I’ll ensure that these charges are adjusted. I appreciate that. How long will it take to correct this? It should be resolved within 48 hours, and I’ll personally follow up with you to confirm. Great, thank you. I want to make sure this doesn’t happen again. Of course! I’ll also review our communication protocols to prevent future issues. That sounds good. By the way, do you have Spanish-speaking caregivers? Yes, we do have Spanish-speaking caregivers available. Would you like me to arrange that for future visits? Yes, please! That would be very helpful for my wife. I can definitely help with that. I’ll make a note for your care plan. Thank you, Margaret. I really appreciate your help today. You’re welcome, Harold. I’ll follow up on the invoice and caregiver arrangements. Sounds good. Have a great day! You too! Take care.
